title: Remote Software Updates and Software Quality
summary: Feedback on G60 software centers on generally favorable impressions of the software itself alongside complaints about difficult or unavailable remote updates, while many mentions only document software versions, update availability, or service guidance without clear sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the software as good and working well, sometimes alongside favorable app feedback.

negative.summary: Negative reviews focus on remote software updates being complicated, slow to restore services, or not arriving over the air and requiring dealer visits.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined mentions mostly record software versions, ask about remote update procedures or notifications, or note an update without expressing a clear opinion.

limitations: Most topic mentions are undetermined, so the sample offers limited evidence about clear satisfaction or dissatisfaction.
The provided examples include only a few explicit positive and negative fragments, so some aspects may be underrepresented.
This is a sentiment-stratified sample rather than a random sample, so it should not be treated as representative of all G60 software experiences.
